bio: This traditional hotel and restaurant located at the edge of the pedestrian area has a gorgeous terrace overlooking the Gut Betha Fountain. On the menu: regional and seasonal cuisine, including locally hunted game. In addition to à la carte dishes, there is an inexpensive three-course set menu (Regiomenü), to be relished in a pleasant atmosphere. The wine list has some surprising rarities in store, and the service is cordial and attentive. They offer several immaculate guestrooms in the building itself, plus holiday apartments within walking distance. You can park free of charge just a few minutes' walk away (Parkplatz Bleiche)....
